title: अध्याय १०४

items.speaker: मार्कण्डेय उवाच
items.text:
लिख्यमाने ततो भानौ विश्वकर्मा प्रजापतिः ।
उद्भूतपुलकः स्तोत्रमिदं चक्रे विवस्वतः ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
likhyamāne tato bhānau viśvakarmā prajāpatiḥ |
udbhūtapulakaḥ stotramidaṃ cakre vivasvataḥ || 1 ||

items.text:
विवस्वते प्रणतहितानुकम्पिने महात्मने समजवसप्तसप्तये ।
सुतेजसे कमलकुलावबोधिने नमस्तमः पटलपटावपाटिने ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
vivasvate praṇatahitānukampine mahātmane samajavasaptasaptaye |
sutejase kamalakulāvabodhine namastamaḥ paṭalapaṭāvapāṭine || 2 ||

items.text:
अजाय लोकत्रयकारणाय भूतात्मने गोपतये वृषाय ।
नमो महाकारुणिकोत्तमाय सूर्याय चक्षुःप्रभवालयाय ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
ajāya lokatrayakāraṇāya bhūtātmane gopataye vṛṣāya |
namo mahākāruṇikottamāya sūryāya cakṣuḥprabhavālayāya || 4 ||

items.text:
विवस्वते ज्ञानमृतेंऽतरात्मने जगत्प्रतिष्ठाय जगद्धितैषिणे ।
स्वयम्भुवे लोकसमस्तचक्षुषे सुरोत्तमायामिततेजसे नमः ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
vivasvate jñānamṛteṃ'tarātmane jagatpratiṣṭhāya jagaddhitaiṣiṇe |
svayambhuve lokasamastacakṣuṣe surottamāyāmitatejase namaḥ || 5 ||

items.text:
क्षणमुदयाचलमौलिमणिः सुरगणमहित हितो जगतः ।
त्वमु मयूखसहस्रवपुर्जगति विभासि तमांसि नुदन् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
kṣaṇamudayācalamaulimaṇiḥ suragaṇamahita hito jagataḥ |
tvamu mayūkhasahasravapurjagati vibhāsi tamāṃsi nudan || 6 ||

items.text:
भवतिमिरासवपानमदाद्भवति विलोहितविग्रहता ।
मिहिर विभासि यतः सुतरां त्रिभुवनभावनभानिकरैः ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
bhavatimirāsavapānamadādbhavati vilohitavigrahatā |
mihira vibhāsi yataḥ sutarāṃ tribhuvanabhāvanabhānikaraiḥ || 7 ||

items.text:
रथमधिरुह्य समावयवं चारुविकम्पितमुरुरुचिरम् ।
सततमखिन्नहयैर्भगवंश्चरसि जगद्धिताय विततम् ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
rathamadhiruhya samāvayavaṃ cāruvikampitamururuciram |
satatamakhinnahayairbhagavaṃścarasi jagaddhitāya vitatam || 8 ||

items.text:
अमृतमयेन रसेन समं विबुधपितॄनपि तर्पयसे ।
अरिगणसूदन तेन तव प्रणतिमुपेत्य लिखामि वपुः ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
amṛtamayena rasena samaṃ vibudhapitṝnapi tarpayase |
arigaṇasūdana tena tava praṇatimupetya likhāmi vapuḥ || 9 ||

items.text:
शुकसमवर्णह्यप्रथितं तव पदपांसुपवित्रतमम् ।
नतजनवत्सल मां प्रणतं त्रिभुवनपावन पाहि रवे ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
śukasamavarṇahyaprathitaṃ tava padapāṃsupavitratamam |
natajanavatsala māṃ praṇataṃ tribhuvanapāvana pāhi rave || 10 ||

items.text:
इति सकलजगप्रसूतिभूतं त्रिभुवनभावनधामहेतुमेकम् ।
रविमखिलजगत्प्रदीपभूतं त्रिदशवर प्रणतोऽस्मि सर्वदा त्वाम् ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
iti sakalajagaprasūtibhūtaṃ tribhuvanabhāvanadhāmahetumekam |
ravimakhilajagatpradīpabhūtaṃ tridaśavara praṇato'smi sarvadā tvām || 11 ||

en_summary: Markandeya tells Kraushtuki that while the sun was being trimmed down on the lathe, Vishvakarma the Prajapati, his hair standing on end, sang this hymn of praise to Vivasvat. He bows to the sun who is kind to those who bow to him, the great soul with seven swift horses, the bright one who wakes the lotuses and tears away the veil of darkness; to the one whose deeds purify, who grants many wishes and does good to all worlds; to the unborn cause of the three worlds, the soul of beings, lord of rays, most compassionate, the home of the eye's light; to the inner soul without whom there is no knowledge, the support of the world, self-born, the eye of all worlds, of boundless brightness. For a moment he is the jewel on the crest of the eastern mountain, honoured by the gods, and with a body of a thousand rays he shines and drives away darkness. He rides his well-made, beautiful chariot with tireless horses for the good of the world, and with his nectar-like essence he satisfies gods and ancestors. Vishvakarma says that, having bowed to him, he now 'writes' (shapes) the sun's body, and prays to the lord, kind to those who bow, purifier of the three worlds, whose horses are green like a parrot and whose foot-dust is most holy, to protect him. He ends by bowing for ever to the sun, the source of all the world, the one lamp of all the worlds.
